title: German Vegetable Soup
description: A hearty and comforting German-style vegetable soup made with a variety of colorful vegetables and aromatic essence.
instructions: Heat a large pot over medium heat.
Add the onions and carrots and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the potatoes and vegetable essence (if using) and stir to combine.
Pour in the vegetable soup and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
